summary: A premium studio-style brand-credibility composition featuring one black seated electric cargo scooter shown from a shallow front-left three-quarter angle on a pale blue-to-white gradient background. The scooter is placed on the right side with its front wheel left of the rear wheel, central tubular cargo enclosure and rear basket both empty, kickstand deployed, cyan rim accents visible on both wheels, and a blue rear suspension spring visible. Large marketing typography appears on the left, two blue laurel badges appear on the upper-right, and an acrylic SGS certificate display sits on translucent blocks at the lower-left.
